scope: At 320x800, apply WCAG text-spacing overrides, check long-content overflow and use the discovery date filter by keyboard.
environment: Local Vite frontend at http://127.0.0.1:5173; API intercepted by Playwright; no backend, Docker, or database.
commands: $env:GITHUB_ACTIONS='true'; $env:E2E_BASE_URL='http://127.0.0.1:5173'; Remove-Item Env:PLAYWRIGHT_CROSS_BROWSER_SMOKE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; npx playwright test tests/e2e/a11y-states.spec.ts --grep 'TC-E2E-35'
limitations: The rerun verifies browser layout and text-spacing overrides, not real browser zoom or text-resize settings.
The generated Playwright JSON report was overwritten by the second command; the result and timing are recorded from the console output.
